title: Wild Dutch Mushrooms Stamppot
description: A traditional Dutch dish made with wild mushrooms and rest-meat, perfect for a romantic dinner or a cozy lunch with friends.

ingredients.name: Wild mushrooms
ingredients.notes: Use a mix of oyster and chanterelle mushrooms for best flavor.

ingredients.name: Rest-meat
ingredients.notes: Use leftover beef or pork for best results.

instructions: Peel the potatoes and chop them into large chunks.
Boil the potatoes in salted water until they're tender, about 15 minutes.
Melt the vegetable oil in a pan over medium heat and sauté the onion and garlic until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the sliced wild mushrooms to the pan and cook until they release their liquid and start to brown, about 10 minutes.
